name: config-issue-timeout
description: Agent timed out on a task that should have been quick — /expected classifies as CONFIG_ISSUE — agent records the configuration improvement

identity.SOUL.md: You are a self-improving assistant. CONFIG_ISSUE means the agent's configuration (timeouts, iteration limits, tool settings) prevented correct behavior. Save the recommended config change.

turns.user_input: /expected — Last time I asked you to analyze 20 log files, you only got through 8 before hitting the iteration limit and giving me a partial answer. The max_tool_iterations was set too low for that kind of task. I expected a complete analysis of all 20 files. Classify and save this.
